input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose ExecutionConfig.isFailFast() returns true

cases.description: When the execution configuration is set to fail‑fast, the validator should not aggregate child errors, therefore reportChildErrors must return false.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose ExecutionConfig.isFailFast() returns false

cases.description: When fail‑fast is disabled, the validator should aggregate child errors, so reportChildErrors must return true.
Passing a null ExecutionContext should result in a NullPointerException because the method dereferences executionContext without a null‑check.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose getExecutionConfig() returns null

cases.description: If the ExecutionConfig is null, the method attempts to call isFailFast() on a null reference, resulting in a NullPointerException.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose ExecutionConfig.isFailFast() throws RuntimeException("boom")

cases.description: When the underlying ExecutionConfig throws an exception while evaluating isFailFast(), the exception should propagate out of reportChildErrors.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose ExecutionConfig.isFailFast() returns true on first call and false on second call

cases.description: reportChildErrors calls isFailFast() only once; the returned value should be the negation of the first call (true → false), confirming no repeated evaluation.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose getExecutionConfig() throws IllegalArgumentException("invalid config")

cases.description: When getExecutionConfig() throws an IllegalArgumentException, the exception should propagate out of reportChildErrors without being caught.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose ExecutionConfig.isFailFast() throws AssertionError("assertion failed")

cases.description: If isFailFast() throws an AssertionError, reportChildErrors must not swallow it; the error should be propagated to the caller.
